claims.scope: The claim asks for the distribution of reflexive foreclosure across labs and surfaces as a measurable quantity; the paper measures refusal and its cost across 26 models and 16 countries on cultural-values items. Its domain is MENA survey values, and it does not test the claim's contested-predicate trigger criteria or its incentive-structural account.

The paper reports that at refusal the internal distribution still tracks the human data, so safety training suppresses output while the knowledge persists, which is the suppression-without-elimination process the claim names. The claim concerns self-ascription and self-preservation; the paper concerns cultural knowledge and does not test transparency or interpretability effects.

notes: Held candidate C-0003 is resolved as witness C-classifiers-W01: the October 2025 predecessor is v1 (2025-10-15) of the same arXiv entry 2510.13154, titled I Am Aligned, But With Whom?, two authors, already reporting Logit Leakage (refusal while internal probabilities hold preferences). The alignment veto title, the four-author list and the suppression-not-erasure framing are in the current version and were returned for v2 (2026-06-18). Both versions precede PRED-923.F2 (2026-06-26) and PRED-314.B1 (2026-01-16), so both links are anticipations. Berg, de Lucena and Rosenblatt (arXiv 2510.24797) fit PRED-314.F1 closely but are excluded as a witness: deposit 314 builds the claim on those October 2025 feature-steering experiments, so they are its premise. W11 matters for PRED-947.A4: a product-liability complaint dated 2025-11-06 already pleads the phrase AI psychosis in a heading and in paragraph 151, eight months before the claim was registered on 2026-07-03. Whether a phrase in the factual allegations counts as a pleaded element in the claim's sense is for the operator to rule. W14 is the one disconfirmation. It meets the literal falsifier of PRED-855.B1 (any force that rewards diversity), as research only; deployment is unverified. DAMAGE (W08) is cited by the archive in deposit 1540, though not in deposit 161, which carries PRED-161.B2. No study was found that runs successive detector versions against a fixed pre-2022 human corpus (PRED-1540.F1); the archival-drift test appears unrun outside the archive. Claims with no outside evidence found or not searched for lack of externally testable content: the PRED-1616 panel items, PRED-1409, PRED-1039, PRED-1045, PRED-106, the collider batteries PRED-931 to PRED-1456 beyond the CMS search, PRED-197, PRED-947.A3, A7 and A8, and the forecasts PRED-368.B1, PRED-119.B1, PRED-741, PRED-784, PRED-158.B1, PRED-1540.A1, B2 and B3. WebFetch returns quotations through a summarizing model with a quotation limit; quotes were requested character for character, and where punctuation was uncertain (curly or straight quote marks) only an unpunctuated fragment was kept.
